response_text:
To convert Fahrenheit to Celsius, use the formula  

\[
°C = (°F - 32) \times \frac{5}{9}
\]

For 72 °F:

\[
\begin{aligned}
°C &= (72 - 32) \times \frac{5}{9} \\
   &= 40 \times \frac{5}{9} \\
   &= \frac{200}{9} \\
   &\approx 22.22^\circ\text{C}
\end{aligned}
\]

**Result:** 72 °F is approximately **22.2 °C**.
